{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Inspect basic info: dtypes, nulls, duplicates
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nDtypes:")
print(df.dtypes)
print("\nMissing values:")
print(df.isnull().sum())
print("\nUnique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Duplicate patient_id:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("\nCount of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for assay_batch differences
print("\nAssay batch distribution:")
print(df['assay_batch'].value_counts())

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient
print("\nMax sample_seq per patient:")
print(df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts())

# Check if all patients have both baseline and final values
print("\nPatients with missing baseline or final biomarker:")
print(df[['biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final']].isnull().any(axis=1).sum())"}
